title: Basic Combustion Phenomena
description: Simultaneous application of fluid mechanics, heat and mass transfer, chemical kinetics and thermodynamics to combustion. Topics covered include chemical kinetics, chain and thermal explosions, detonation and deflagration, flammability limits, stirred reactors. Flame stabilization in high and low velocity streams, laminar and turbulent diffusion flames, droplet burning, and metal combustion.
prerequisites: AER 320, AER 330 or ME 330, AER 325 or ME 325, and engineering standing; or graduate standing
